name: Data Pipelines - OpenSearch
description: Provides an OpenSearch destination for data pipelines.
project_description: Data Pipelines - OpenSearch adds an 'opensearch' dataset destination plugin to the Data Pipelines module. It ships an OpenSearch client factory (built on opensearch-project/opensearch-php) and thin request/value-object wrappers so that a Data Pipelines dataset can be written into an OpenSearch cluster: an index is created per dataset (named prefix + dataset machine name), processed chunks are bulk-indexed as documents, invalid rows are bulk-deleted, and the last processed delta is read back for resume support. The destination is configured per pipeline (URL, username, password, index prefix) from the Data Pipelines destination UI.
